name: rally-backend
description: Backend for the rally website: daily Wikipedia collector, Firestore storage and a read-only API.

scripts.collect:emulator: PATH=/opt/homebrew/opt/openjdk/bin:$PATH firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-rally --import ../emulator-data --export-on-exit ../emulator-data "node scripts/collect-to-firestore.js $YEARS"
scripts.api:check: PATH=/opt/homebrew/opt/openjdk/bin:$PATH firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,functions --project demo-rally --import ../emulator-data "node scripts/check-api.js"
